show.description: Manisha’s life is shattered when she discovers she is pregnant after being drugged and spending a night with a stranger. As fear and confusion give way to shocking truth, she learns the man involved is a powerful billionaire. Caught between trauma, secrecy, and social judgment, Manisha must navigate a world that questions her character while she struggles to reclaim control over her body, dignity, and future.
